headline: Nyanzaga Mine strikes gold at TMIC 2026 as it readies for its production
summary: The Nyanzaga Gold Project, in Sengerema District, Mwanza Region, is joining Tanzania's gold sector as a new investor. First gold pour is targeted for January 2027 after 17 years of exploration and construction.
why: New gold mines add to global supply and expand investment in African mining. Timing of first production affects the project's economics.
